channel.title: SYS//VAULT - Daily Design, Motion & AI Prompt Systems
channel.description: Autonomous daily radar of UI layouts, 60fps motion specs, typography pairings, and AI prompt systems.

item.title: [UI & Layout] Vibrant Gradient Fix: Perceptual Blends
item.description: Traditional RGB blending interpolates colors linearly, often creating muddy mid-points due to human perception of lightness. Adopting perceptual color spaces like LCH ensures smooth, visually harmonious transitions, significantly enhancing visual appeal in UI elements. | Fonts: Inter Display + Fira Sans | Palette: #1A2CFF #FFD700 #FF4500 #00FF7F | Prompt: Design a UI card with a vibrant background gradient from #FFD700 to #1A2CFF. Ensure the gradient uses LCH color interpolation for a perceptually smooth transition, avoiding any muddy mid-tones. Include a subtle radial texture overlay at 15% opacity. Display a clear call-to-action button centered.

This workflow drastically reduces manual correction time and guarantees consistent visual and textual brand identity across all AI-produced assets, from UI components to marketing copy. | Palette: #007BFF #28A745 #6C757D #F8F9FA | Unlock full Typography & Production Prompt Spec in SYS//VAULT ($19).

item.title: [UI & Layout] Authentic Chat UI Blueprint
item.description: People instantly spot fake chat UIs. Mastering nuanced details like bubble geometry, tail placement, and dark mode consistency builds immediate trust and perceived professionalism, making your mockups indistinguishable from live apps. This translates to higher engagement and design credibility. | Fonts: Inter (Display) + SF Mono (Body/Mono) | Palette: #0A84FF #E5E5EA #3C3C43 #F2F2F7 | Prompt: Design a modern chat UI for a mobile app. Ensure realistic bubble radii, subtle tail geometry, and thoughtful message grouping. Include a status bar, read receipts, and seamless dark mode adaptation. Focus on minute details that convey a genuine, live conversation flow, not static elements.

item.title: [Motion & 3D] Stretchy Toggle Interaction
item.description: Users expect interactive elements to feel alive and responsive. The knob should stretch horizontally on activation, then slide smoothly. Track color shifts subtly from #E0E0E0 (off) to #5C6BC0 (on). Ensure ARIA attributes are correctly applied for screen readers.
